text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
*Haa, fuu*...! Great work, everyone!
That was a nice race!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
That girl over there... Manhattan Cafe, was it?
Good work out there...

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Wait, huh... You're not listening?
Um...
With her back turned to the other Umamusume, Manhattan Cafe was staring into the distance.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
choice_data_list: How did the race turn out?
So, what happened in the race?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
...It's my 'friend's' victory. She ran ahead
all on her own. Passing the goal line...
and going far, far away...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
They looked so happy
to run in such a wide-open space. But on the other hand...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
"She was so fast, like she'd been liberated from something.
The gap... widened like nothing I'd ever seen before..."

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
...I want to chase after them. But to catch up...
what should I do...?

"From the sound of it, there seems to be a considerable difference
in speed between her 'friend' and Manhattan Cafe."
In that case, rushing a plan would be impossible to begin with. Which means—
choice_data_list: Let's not set a target race and focus on steady improvement.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Steadily, bit by bit...
That means it's going to take a very long time...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
...Understood.
Let us go with that, then...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
...Yes. It can't be helped...
If doing it right away is impossible...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
"Besides, this might actually be for the best...
My body... isn't very strong, after all..."

I nod and step up beside her, vowing that
we will chase down that same goal together.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Hey. Don't those two seem a bit strange...?
Just staring off into the distance like that.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
"Birds of a feather, I guess...?
I'd better keep my distance..."

Understanding the things only she can comprehend...
Let's stack up our achievements, one by one.
